title: Web Search Agent with DuckDuckGo
description: Build a conversational AI agent that can search the web in real-time using DuckDuckGo to provide up-to-date information on any topic

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Integrates DuckDuckGo search API for real-time web information retrieval
Implements custom tools for handling search queries and results processing
Features comprehensive error handling for rate limits and API failures
Supports multiple deployment options including local, Lambda, and Fargate
Provides interactive conversational interface for natural search interactions
